purpose: Teach: ほうれん草/ワックス/立ち寄る/小さめ/お喋り/ひと言/燃やす/グチ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、ほうれん草、絶対、料理、絶対、お父さん、絶対、大好きだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, you were genuinely crazy about my spinach dishes, weren't you? I still remember.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward in time. Warm nostalgia on the opening. Unhurried rhythm, letting each memory settle. A small, genuine smile in the voice — not performing, remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、車に、絶対、ワックス、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、塗ってくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Mm. And back then, you — you used to wax the car so carefully for me. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle reciprocal warmth. Matching his pace but with a subtle lift — she's offering her own memory back to him. Voice softens on 'carefully.' A little wonder that he still remembers too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、商店街に、絶対、立ち寄る、絶対、と、絶対、皆、絶対、声を、絶対、かけてくれたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, everyone at the shopping street would call out to us whenever we'd stop by. You remember that, Gran?
lines.style: Quiet delight in the memory. A light touch on 'everyone' — pride without bragging. Pace stays steady, conversational. Slight lift at the end, inviting her into the shared past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、家、絶対、小さめ、絶対、でも、絶対、温かったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's right — your house was small back then, but it was always so warm. You remember, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Affirming his memory while adding her own layer. 'Small' carries no judgment, just fact. Voice swells slightly on 'warm' — that was the point. Steady and sure, matching his cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんと、絶対、お喋り、絶対、夜中まで、絶対、続いたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And we'd talk — you and I would talk late into the night. You remember that?
lines.style: Soft and direct, almost wondering. Voice drops slightly into the intimacy of 'late into the night.' Not wistful, but present — he's there, she's there, in the memory. Trailing pause at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんから、絶対、ひと言、絶対、励まし、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、嬉しかったわよ、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: It was your few words of encouragement that meant so much to me back then. You know that, don't you?
lines.style: Tender vulnerability beneath composure. Emphasis falls gently on 'few words' — the rarity made them precious. Voice slightly thickens on 'meant so much.' Not asking for reassurance, stating what was true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、たき火、絶対、を、絶対、お父さん、絶対、よく、絶対、燃やす、絶対、ことが、絶対、あったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Back when you were young, you used to tend the fire quite often. Remember that, Gran?
lines.style: Simple observation delivered with quiet affection. 'Tend the fire' carries ritual weight — something he did, something ordinary that was actually meaningful. Unhurried. Ends with a soft question, not demanding but inviting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、グチ、絶対、を言わない、絶対、人だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: You were never one to complain back then — that's what I remember about you, dear.
lines.style: Soft admiration without flattery. Slow delivery on 'never one to complain' — it's a small thing that matters. Voice settles into quiet respect. Closing with 'dear' carries the full weight of decades of knowing him.
